main_text.p: מַעֲטָה f. Acuminatus, Exactus instar styli; Ezech.21.15.
עַטִּין עָטִין m. Mulctrale: plur. עֲטִינִים.

עָטַף Operire: Obtegi, operiri, Obrui, quod cum de animo dicitur, est, Deficere, Deliquium pati. עֲטֻפִים Obruti: item Serotina, Serotina pecudes vel oves. Niphal Infinit. בְּעָטֵף In obruendo, Cum obruretur, Thren.2.11. Est autem contractum pro בְּהָעָטֵף. Hiphil Infin. וּבְהַעֲטִיף Et in serotinando, quum serò coirent oves. Hithpahel הִתְעַטֵּף Obrui.
עָטַר Circumcingere, Circumcludere, Circumtegere. Pihel עִטֵּר Coronare, Circumtegere. Hiphil Part. מַעֲטִירָה Coronans vel Coronaria, Iesa.23.8.
עֲטָרָה עֲטֶרֶת f. Corona: plur. עֲטָרוֹת.
עִיב Qua huius forma sunt, Vide in עוֹב.
עִי m. Cumulus, Acervus: plur. עִיִּים;

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Latin abbreviations (e.g. "Multrale", "Iesa") are as printed or read with doubt from a small scan; the Hebrew forms in the entries, especially the points, are the least certain parts. "Mulctrale" in the Latin may be misread as "Multrale" in the printed form.
